toegepas.blok: Vuil water kan 'n mens maagsiek maak
toegepas.voor: kom die kieme saam met die water in.
toegepas.na: sluk hy die kieme saam met die water in.
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'kom ... in' leaves it unclear where the germs come in; 'sluk ... in' is the natural verb for drinking and keeps the meaning.
toegepas.fout: 'kom die kieme saam met die water in' leaves open where the germs come in; the verb is vague for the act of drinking.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'sluk hy ... in' is the natural verb for drinking, keeps the same event and order, touches no protected word, and 'hy' refers clearly to 'iemand'.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'met 'n grootmens by' is a loose colloquial construction; 'saam met' is standard and keeps 'altyd' and the adult rule intact.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'met 'n grootmens by' is idiomatic Afrikaans for an adult being present, so this is a lateral move inside a safety instruction (who must be there), and that wording stays as checked.

na_skrywer.voor: 'n Gas in die lug wat bome en plante opneem.
na_skrywer.na: 'n Gas in die lug wat deur bome en plante opgeneem word.
na_skrywer.rede_vinder: The relative 'wat' can grammatically be read as the gas taking up the trees; the passive makes clear the plants take up the gas.
na_skrywer.fout: The relative 'wat' in 'wat bome en plante opneem' can grammatically read as the gas taking up the trees and plants.
na_skrywer.rede_keurder: The ambiguity is real but this is a [begrip] definition, which may be shared across lessons and changes only through the writer; the parallel 'suurstof' entry ('wat mense en baie diere inasem') has the same structure and should be judged together with it.
na_skrywer.waarom: the reviewer sent it to the writer

laat_vaar_vorige.blok: Vullis wat lê waar dit nie hoort nie
laat_vaar_vorige.voor: waar vullis beland waar dit nie hoort nie
laat_vaar_vorige.na: waar vullis beland wat nie daar hoort nie
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: Avoids the clumsy 'waar ... waar' repetition without changing the meaning or the length.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'Waar ... waar' is acceptable, and the restrictive 'vullis wat nie daar hoort nie' quietly suggests some litter does belong there; it also breaks the parallel with the heading and the glossary wording.

laat_vaar_vorige.blok: Vuil water kan 'n mens maagsiek maak
laat_vaar_vorige.voor: lyk soms skoon en is dit tog nie
laat_vaar_vorige.na: lyk soms skoon maar is dit tog nie
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: The sentence is a contrast, so 'maar' is the natural joiner; no comma because the second half shares the subject.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'En is dit tog nie' is natural Afrikaans, since 'tog' already carries the contrast; swapping in 'maar' is a lateral move.
